yaya.context.title: Context

yaya.context.mode_off: Do nothing (always send the full history)

yaya.context.budget_hint: Empty = auto: 75% of the context window from model metadata, or 96K if unknown. Estimated from text length, not exact.
yaya.context.keep_turns: Always keep the most recent turns
yaya.context.step_drop: Context too long: the earliest {n} messages are no longer sent
yaya.context.marker_compress: The {n} messages above were compressed into a summary

yaya.settings.plugins.defaults_note: These switches are the defaults for new assistants; each existing assistant has its own under Assistants → Plugins / MCP. Plugin settings, MCP servers and Skills are shared by all assistants.
yaya.settings.policy_defaults_note: Tool confirmation and max steps are the defaults for new assistants; each existing assistant has its own under Assistants → Execution policy.
yaya.assistants.mcp_desc: Choose which MCP servers this assistant can use. Add or edit servers under Settings → Plugins → MCP; they are shared by all assistants
